findings.title: Invalidate connected calendars after deleting cached data
findings.body: The cache deletion mutation only invokes the optional onSuccess callback and never invalidates viewer.calendars.connectedCalendars. The wrapper gets cacheUpdatedAt from that query, disables refetchOnWindowFocus, and does not provide a default onChanged callback that refreshes it. Consequently, a successful deletion leaves the old cache timestamp and delete action visible until the query is otherwise refreshed. Invalidate the connected-calendars query on successful deletion, as the disconnect mutation already does.

findings.title: Make the environment-file update work with GNU sed
findings.body: The command uses the BSD/macOS form `sed -i ''`, which fails with GNU sed on Linux because the empty argument is interpreted as the script rather than an in-place backup suffix. When GOOGLE_WEBHOOK_URL already exists, the script therefore leaves the old tunnel URL in the environment file but still prints a success message. Subsequent webhook subscriptions use the stale URL. Use a portable update mechanism or handle BSD and GNU sed separately, and check the update's exit status.
